case_manifest.description: Canonical hash of the pre-existing case objects (including the semantic oracle and posting status). A future edit that changes any listed field fails test_posting_mapping_fixture_integrity.
case_manifest.canonicalization: sha256(json.dumps([{field: case.get(field) for field in case_fields} for case in cases sorted by id], sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False))

job_manifest.description: Canonical hash of the pre-existing job objects excluding fillers. Filler-only re-tuning is the only permitted change to these jobs.
job_manifest.canonicalization: sha256(json.dumps([{field: job.get(field) for field in job_fields} for job in jobs sorted by code], sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False))
